scientific limitations/integrity: The result is a local Taylor classification for Möbius deformations of the Clifford three-torus. It does not assert global monotonicity along a full Möbius orbit or resolve the corresponding degenerate locus in every dimension. The proof starts from the exact Möbius integral formula in the primary preprint, reduces directions by torus phase symmetry to three block weights, and performs exact phase averaging through eighth order. A bundled symbolic checker independently reconstructs the coefficients and the secondary-degeneracy sign.
title: Sixth-order phase split on the degenerate Clifford 3-torus Möbius boundary
